notes:
v4.6.62 — IBKR bots reliably sell + reconnect (major stability fixes)

🐛 FIXED — IBKR bots 'struggling to sell' / showing +0%
• Orders were being rejected by IBKR ('Error 10349 — TIF set by order preset') and silently cancelled. Orders now set an explicit time-in-force + allow-outside-RTH so sells, buys and bracket exits actually fill.
• A cancelled/rejected order is no longer mistakenly recorded as a fill — this previously desynced a bot's holdings (e.g. went negative) and inflated cash.
• If the gateway connection drops, the bot now automatically reconnects instead of failing every price/trade with 'Not connected' (and no longer mislabels a held stock as 'not tradeable').

🛠️ SERVER STABILITY (cloud bots)
• A spawn lock prevents two copies of the same bot from starting and fighting over one IBKR connection (the root cause of the connect failures).
• Crashed/zombie bot processes and a stale virtual-display lock no longer block a clean restart of the gateway and bots.

Result: your IBKR Day/Long bots connect cleanly, show exact entry prices & P/L, and can sell.

Update via the in-app banner.
